name: Blackout Clock
short: A news calendar for prop-firm traders that shows which of their accounts are blocked by each firm's news rules.
role: Product and design; I direct an AI agent team that builds it
stack: Next.js, Supabase, Postgres cron jobs, Web Push, Vercel

images.alt: Blackout Clock Today view: a 24-hour timeline of news lock windows per account (demo trader)
Blackout Clock desktop Now + Today view and phone Now screen (sample data)
Account rows showing locked, pairs-only and clear status with countdowns (sample data)

stats.label: days from first commit to live

highlights: Now, Today and Week views show which accounts are locked, and until when
Push alerts 5 and 1 minutes before each lock window
Rule Radar checks each firm's rule page daily and flags changes for review
Every rule shows its source and check date; an unknown rule is never shown as clear
next: Confirm alert timing on real devices
